title: Digital Tool Adoption — Credentials exist consistent usage does not
rootCause: Staff have PL24 access but continue to default to phone and fax ordering out of habit and familiarity. No internal champion has been designated to drive daily tool usage. AOS basket is incomplete which further reduces confidence in placing orders through the system — staff do not trust the basket to reflect what they need.
impact: +€6200/month estimated if PL24 order share reaches regional average of 81%

title: Overdue Action Backlog — 3 actions open past agreed deadlines
rootCause: Actions agreed on 26 Feb were not reviewed between visits. No internal process at the dealer for tracking agreed commitments — actions are only revisited when the field executive is present. Two actions require Anna Schmidt's involvement but she has not been given dedicated time to complete them.
impact: Execution credibility risk — pattern of open actions undermines coaching relationship and delays KPI recovery

title: IR Response Time — Order fulfilment and query resolution not consistently meeting IR expectations
rootCause: IRs choose suppliers based on speed, convenience, and reliability. Feedback from the last visit indicates Alpha Garage is not consistently meeting IR expectations on order turnaround times. Manual processes and phone-based ordering create delays that digital channels would eliminate. Without structured data on response times, the dealer cannot identify where in the process the delay occurs.
impact: IR retention risk — slow or inconsistent response pushes IRs toward alternative suppliers who offer faster digital ordering and more predictable service
